evidence_tiers.A_PIT_SNAPSHOT: Provider supplies a timestamped point-in-time sportsbook snapshot at or before the requested decision time.
evidence_tiers.B_LINE_MOVEMENT: Provider supplies timestamped opening-to-closing movement but not an exact requested PIT snapshot.
evidence_tiers.C_OPEN_CLOSE: Provider supplies sportsbook-specific opening and closing observations only.
evidence_tiers.D_RESULTS_CONTEXT: Authoritative results/context only; never sufficient for market PIT calibration by itself.

source_registry.notes: Historical snapshots; preserve returned timestamp/previous_timestamp/next_timestamp and exact raw bytes.
Preserve every provider movement timestamp and sportsbook identity; do not treat overwritten non-odds historical fields as PIT revisions.
Rolling retention means August recovery should be attempted immediately; retain detected movement timestamps.
Opening/closing lines are useful for CLV support but are not a substitute for an exact decision-time snapshot.
Authoritative game identity/results lane; never market evidence.

decision_capture.definition: Exact quote set used by the V8 decision engine, captured before recommendation/execution with run_id, model/distribution SHA, quote timestamps and source provenance.

close_capture.definition: Last verifiable pre-first-pitch quote snapshot per sportsbook/market, stored separately from decision evidence.
